subject: MSA & Order Form: party owners, template gap analysis and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form: party owners, template gap analysis and evidence checklist

Clara —

Thanks for the time last week. We're ready to kick off the MSA + Order Form for the Proof-of-Concept commit. To help us scope redlines and assess any template gaps, can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow?

- Authorized signers (name, title, email) and billing contact.
- Which legal entity will sign (AvaSoft, AvaSoft US, or parent?).
- Data residency requirement (US-only, EU, or multi-region).
- Any minimum insurance or SOC2/ISO evidence we should expect (feel free to attach summary).
- The initial order form: do you prefer we use our standard Redwood template or do you want to propose your counterparty document?

I've attached a short intake checklist and a CSV template for signers to make this easier. Once we have this we can run a quick template gap analysis and estimate turnaround for legal review.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AVASOFT_INTK_Checklist.pdf (1 page), AvaSoft_Signers.csv (sample)

From: Clara Reynolds <clara.reynolds@avasoft.com>

Cc: James Lin <james.lin@avasoft.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form: party owners, template gap analysis and evidence checklist

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — see answers below and I've attached the signers file.

- Authorized signer: James Lin (VP Finance) — james.lin@avasoft.com
- Billing contact: Maria Gonzalez (Accounting) — maria.gonzalez@avasoft.com
- Legal entity: AvaSoft Inc. (US subsidiary).
- Data residency: production data must remain in US regions; dev/test can be multi-region.
- Security evidence: we can provide a SOC2 summary and contact for full report (attached SOC2-Summary.pdf).
- Template: we prefer Redwood's standard MSA if possible, but we have a few mandatory clauses to surface (listed below).

Mandatory items from our side:
1) Carve-out for export control compliance language (we'll share corporate language).
2) Data deletion confirmation on contract termination (30 days recommended).
3) 12-month lookback audit rights for security incidents.

I've attached AvaSoft_Signers.csv and SOC2-Summary.pdf. Happy to jump on a 20m sync if you want to walk through.

Best,
Clara Reynolds
Head of Legal Operations, AvaSoft
clara.reynolds@avasoft.com

Attachments: AvaSoft_Signers.csv, SOC2-Summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MSA & Order Form: party owners, template gap analysis and evidence checklist

Thanks for the details and the SOC2 summary — very helpful. Quick read-through and initial notes (high level):

- Entity: AvaSoft Inc. — confirm EIN/site address for Exhibit A.
- Data residency: US-only production requirement — we'll flag a hard data residency clause and propose an acceptable routing/fallback policy.
- Security: SOC2 summary looks current; request full report under NDA if we need to run a vendor risk assessment.
- Mandatory items: we should accept the data-deletion 30-day window but propose a certificate-of-deletion standard language. For 12-month lookback audit rights, pushback expected — propose scoped audit + remote evidence + redaction options.
- Insurance & liability: ask for current limits (we'll compare to Redwood policy).

Action items for legal redline prep:
1) Karthik — can you spin up a draft MSA using Redwood standard and insert AvaSoft entity + Exhibit A details? Put the mandatory clauses Clara listed under a "Customer Mandatory Provisions" annex to avoid template churn.
2) Naomi — please confirm billing contact address and billing cadence for the order form.
3) I'll request SOC2 full report link; we'll attach under NDA if provided.

I'll mark this medium priority — expect a first-pass redline in 48-72 hours after Karthik's draft.

Perfect — I'll assemble the MSA + Order Form draft today and drop it into the Contracts intake folder. Plan:

- Generate Redwood standard MSA populated with AvaSoft Inc. party fields and Exhibit A (billing contact + address).
- Create an annex for "Customer Mandatory Provisions" with Clara's three items; we'll propose reasonable legal tradeoffs in comments.
- Flag the 12-month audit right as "scope-limited" and propose remote evidence plus redactions.
- Attach SOC2-Summary to the intake ticket and request full report under NDA if needed.

Marissa: assign to Contracts queue (priority: P2). Naomi: please confirm Maria Gonzalez billing email and the billing address used on the PO so I can populate Exhibit B.

I'll aim for first-pass redline by EOD tomorrow and will paste the HubSpot/CLM link here when created.

Thanks —
